# Survey

## Summary
A set of questions put to an audience, and the card people answer.
The isolated view is the live fill-in flow (question wizard, validation,
submit) plus an aggregated results view; fitted advertises the survey with
its question count. The catalog's survey listing keeps its own copy, since
a listing installs as a self-contained package.

## API
- `title`, `description` (markdown)
- `questions` — containsMany SurveyQuestion (see the Questionnaire spec for kinds/options/required)
- `questionCount` — computed
- `publishedAt` — written once by Publish Survey; `isPublished` derives from it
- Submitting creates a SurveyResponse (see the Form Response spec) linked back to this card

## Usage
```ts
import { Survey } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/survey/survey';

@field feedbackSurvey = linksTo(Survey);
```
A consumer that triggers surveys (post-event feedback, support CSAT)
links to one Survey and points respondents at it; responses accumulate
as their own cards, queryable by `survey.id`.

## Non-goals
No audience targeting, scheduling or reminders — when a survey goes out
is the consumer's workflow. Response incentives (points for completing)
belong to the consumer wiring its own commands. Aggregation beyond the
built-in results view (cross-survey reporting) is a query the consumer
owns.
